evidence.statement: Featureless or ordinary additive-seasonal flat MAP uses matching absmax/minmax scaling, level/feature/noise priors and exact-constant shortcuts. Fitted output and persistence gates remain required. The Python input adapter explicitly maps shared numeric cells to float64, including integer-spelled constant targets, without altering numeric values or fitted/serialized state.

The original mixed-flat recipes and their exact rolling prefixes are independently fit with matching absmax or minmax scaling, conditional multiplicative seasonality, additive event and regressor. Direct fits do not inherit Python CV's scaling-copy omission.

Shared complete histories exercise stable sorting, independently weighted duplicate rows, row-index automatic candidates (including repeats), and zero-span numerical outcomes. Only finite comparable results passing the existing quantity tolerances admit timings; failures and NaN forecasts are migration findings, not parity successes.
Explicit shared rolling-origin folds use public evaluation entrypoints but differ in fitted-model setup, uncertainty algorithm, metrics policy, and report shape; absolute timings only.
Both adapters publicly restore the same intercept, slope, time origin, and time scale before prediction.
Both adapters fit the same nonempty explicit-changepoint linear MAP objective with no additive feature columns.
Both adapters fit matching explicit changepoints and identically ordered custom Fourier columns and prior scales.
Both adapters fit two matching UTC/naive-calendar event groups with six offset columns, overlapping activation, future occurrences, and one explicit changepoint.
Both adapters fit four ordered additive regressors using binary auto, numeric auto, numeric always, and numeric never transforms with matching explicit changepoints.
Both adapters fit two order-three weekly seasonalities gated by matching dense and sparse boolean masks with matching explicit changepoints.

The fixture-scale control combines unconditional and conditional seasonalities, one event, one never-standardized regressor, and the explicit changepoint settings represented by conditional-map-fit.json.

Effect omits map and resolves its automatic 25/0.8 defaults while Python explicitly receives n_changepoints=25 and changepoint_range=0.8; both fit the same ten Fourier and ten additional-feature columns.

The same large-offset linear MAP rows are fit separately with matching absmax or minmax target scaling, explicit changepoint and additive Fourier priors; scaling variants are not equated with each other.
Flat MAP with minmax scaling and a conditional multiplicative seasonality, additive event and regressor; Python's prior-only trend parameters are at their MAP modes.
Linear MAP with nonzero target offset, inherited multiplicative seasonality and explicit additive event/regressor overrides.

Nonsingular logistic MAP with nonempty explicit or automatic changepoints, changing capacities, matched floor and scaling policy, additive Fourier effects and optional multiplicative regressor; no empty-point or singular-rate parity claim.

Versioned linear MAP counterparts retain the original rows, priors, scaling and forecast gates at a 10000-step per-attempt budget. Both select Newton below 100 retained rows and L-BFGS otherwise with original-initialization Newton fallback. Independent executable proportional density, constrained KKT residual and normalized noise gates qualify timings; literal stopping is not a KKT certificate.

Jeremy-approved EP-096 closeout retains the v2 solver, datasets, priors, controls, 10000-step per-attempt budget and existing forecast/component/persistence gates. Independent proportional density differs by at most 0.01 and normalized noise by at most 0.0002. Finite nonnegative constrained stationarity residuals remain mandatory reported diagnostics, but their cross-endpoint equality and near-stationarity certification are deferred to EP-097. Same-point objective/gradient fidelity has separate frozen numerical evidence. No optimum or bitwise trajectory claim is made; archived v2 equality-gate failures remain unchanged.
checks: finite reported stationarity with EP-097 deferral
